prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure blue (#0000FF) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the man of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the man of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. He has these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the pointed charcoal hood whose tip stands up, pulled down to the eyebrows; (2) the dark scarf wrapped twice around the neck and up over his mouth and nose; (3) the strip of overlapping iron scales over each shoulder; (4) the long vertical scar through the left eyebrow; (5) the charm of a bent iron nail on a thong; (6) the long knife of dark iron. He carries no shield. Paint the marks in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left), with a neutral grey fill; do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

The last attempt drifted in these cells: cell 11 (falling). In every cell, and in these above all, keep the figure as Image 1 draws it: the same pose, the same facing, the same size, the same length and breadth of the body on the ground, and the same place in its cell.

Light, for this blue background: the high sun from the upper left and a soft neutral grey fill on the lower right; the shadow side is warm brown-grey and the iron is dark grey with pale grey highlights; nothing on the figure is blue or reflects blue, not even the edge of a blade.

Background: one flat pure blue (#0000FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no blue anywhere on the figures: no blue cloth, no blue light, no blue reflections. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
